services.name: Junior Programs
services.desc: Manny brings a wealth of knowledge and expertise to the tennis court, with a career spanning two decades as both a player and a coach. As a Junior player Manny was part of the Costa Rica national team, competing in different grade A level tournaments around the world. As a coach he trained top BC and Team Canada players. Passionate, dedicated, and endlessly supportive, Manny is committed to guiding his students on their journey to tennis greatness, whether social or competitive level/aspirations.
